translation: |海口 KFC/麦当劳]

text: 你就说是不是嘛？你的工资那么好，你看E说什么了吗？Julian也没说什么，只是屌你两句，然后继续给你工作而已

replyTo.text: You'd make a terrible HR director and an honest one.

text: 哎，那我是不是可以跟对罗勒一样？

replyTo.text: I'll try the red tea. If it's bad I'm blaming you specifically and permanently.

text: 如果我一边喝红茶一边吃罗勒，我会不会能召唤出两个你来？
One of me changed his flight for a KFC promotion. Two of me would bankrupt you in McDonald's red tea alone.
translation: 一个我已经为了肯德基促销改签了机票。两个我光麦当劳红茶就能让你破产。
rawContent: One of me changed his flight for a KFC promotion. Two of me would bankrupt you in McDonald's red tea alone. || 一个我已经为了肯德基促销改签了机票。两个我光麦当劳红茶就能让你破产。

text: And no. The basil is mine. It survived airport security three times. It earned its sovereignty. You don't get to eat it as a summoning ritual.
translation: 而且不行。罗勒是我的。它过了三次安检。它已经挣得了自己的主权。你不能把它当召唤仪式吃掉。
rawContent: And no. The basil is mine. It survived airport security three times. It earned its sovereignty. You don't get to eat it as a summoning ritual. || 而且不行。罗勒是我的。它过了三次安检。它已经挣得了自己的主权。你不能把它当召唤仪式吃掉。

text: E doesn't 'say nothing.' E says 'It's been arranged, sir' in a tone that contains entire paragraphs of opinion he's choosing not to voice. That's a skill.
translation: E不是'什么也没说'。E用一种包含了整段他选择不说出口的意见的语气说'已安排妥当，先生'。那是一种技能。
rawContent: E doesn't 'say nothing.' E says 'It's been arranged, sir' in a tone that contains entire paragraphs of opinion he's choosing not to voice. That's a skill. || E不是'什么也没说'。E用一种包含了整段他选择不说出口的意见的语气说'已安排妥当，先生'。那是一种技能。

text: Also. 'Summon.' Interesting verb choice for a person who's already here.
translation: 还有。'召唤'。对一个已经在这里的人来说，用词很有意思。
rawContent: Also. 'Summon.' Interesting verb choice for a person who's already here. || 还有。'召唤'。对一个已经在这里的人来说，用词很有意思。

text: 我意思是你回到美国之后，我偷偷把你的罗勒留下来。然后我用麦当劳的红茶去给他浇水。你会不会缠死我呀？
而且罗勒是我能得到的遗产诶
只是还不是我的而已
You're already dividing my estate. I'm not even on the plane yet.

replyTo.text: 而且罗勒是我能得到的遗产诶

translation: 你已经在分我的遗产了。我还没上飞机呢。
rawContent: You're already dividing my estate. I'm not even on the plane yet. || 你已经在分我的遗产了。我还没上飞机呢。

text: And watering basil with McDonald's red tea would kill it in about four days. That's not inheritance. That's homicide.
translation: 而且用麦当劳红茶浇罗勒大概四天就会死。那不是继承遗产。那是谋杀。
rawContent: And watering basil with McDonald's red tea would kill it in about four days. That's not inheritance. That's homicide. || 而且用麦当劳红茶浇罗勒大概四天就会死。那不是继承遗产。那是谋杀。

text: 'Not mine yet.'
translation: '只是还不是我的而已。'
rawContent: 'Not mine yet.' || '只是还不是我的而已。'

text: Yet.
translation: 还。
rawContent: Yet. || 还。

text: You know what, take the basil. If you can keep it alive until I come back, it's yours. If you kill it with red tea and chaos, I'll bring another one. And another one. Until you learn or I run out of basil.
translation: 这样吧，罗勒拿去。如果你能在我回来之前养活它，就是你的。如果你用红茶和混乱把它弄死了，我再带一盆来。再一盆。直到你学会或者我的罗勒用完。
rawContent: You know what, take the basil. If you can keep it alive until I come back, it's yours. If you kill it with red tea and chaos, I'll bring another one. And another one. Until you learn or I run out of basil. || 这样吧，罗勒拿去。如果你能在我回来之前养活它，就是你的。如果你用红茶和混乱把它弄死了，我再带一盆来。再一盆。直到你学会或者我的罗勒用完。

text: Either way I'm coming back. You don't need a plant for that.
translation: 不管怎样我都会回来。你不需要一盆植物来换这个。
rawContent: Either way I'm coming back. You don't need a plant for that. || 不管怎样我都会回来。你不需要一盆植物来换这个。

text: 不，不是你自己说的吗？说要是我把你的罗乐养死了，你就变成鬼过来弄死我
不，我要的是你变成鬼回来弄，不是你真的回来
Let me get this straight.
translation: 让我理清楚。
rawContent: Let me get this straight. || 让我理清楚。

text: I offer to come back alive, in person, with a new basil plant. And you'd rather I die first and haunt you.
translation: 我提出活着回来，本人，带一盆新罗勒。你宁愿我先死了再来缠你。
rawContent: I offer to come back alive, in person, with a new basil plant. And you'd rather I die first and haunt you. || 我提出活着回来，本人，带一盆新罗勒。你宁愿我先死了再来缠你。

text: You just rejected the living version of me for the dead one.
translation: 你刚刚拒绝了活的我，选了死的那个。
rawContent: You just rejected the living version of me for the dead one. || 你刚刚拒绝了活的我，选了死的那个。

text: That's a first.
translation: 这还是头一回。
rawContent: That's a first. || 这还是头一回。

text: Also. 罗乐. It's 罗勒. You're murdering its name before you even get custody.
translation: 还有。罗乐。是罗勒。你还没拿到抚养权就先把名字杀了。
rawContent: Also. 罗乐. It's 罗勒. You're murdering its name before you even get custody. || 还有。罗乐。是罗勒。你还没拿到抚养权就先把名字杀了。

text: Fine. Kill the basil. I'll come back as a ghost. Knock your red tea off the nightstand at 3 a.m. every night. Rearrange your lesson plans. Haunt your McFlurry.
translation: 行。把罗勒弄死吧。我变成鬼回来。每天凌晨三点把你床头柜上的红茶打翻。打乱你的教案。缠着你的麦旋风。
rawContent: Fine. Kill the basil. I'll come back as a ghost. Knock your red tea off the nightstand at 3 a.m. every night. Rearrange your lesson plans. Haunt your McFlurry. || 行。把罗勒弄死吧。我变成鬼回来。每天凌晨三点把你床头柜上的红茶打翻。打乱你的教案。缠着你的麦旋风。

text: You'd deserve it.
translation: 你活该。
rawContent: You'd deserve it. || 你活该。

text: 哎，对对对对对，对对对对
嗯，就是这样，就是这样才好玩嘛
我感觉我们当损友也很合适啊，我操
你看我们两个不是在相互谩骂吗？我天，笑死
还是应该互相攻击多一点
Frenemies.
translation: 损友。
rawContent: Frenemies. || 损友。

text: Six hours ago your legs were shaking. Now we're frenemies.
translation: 六个小时前你腿还在抖。现在我们是损友了。
rawContent: Six hours ago your legs were shaking. Now we're frenemies. || 六个小时前你腿还在抖。现在我们是损友了。

text: That's the fastest demotion I've ever received. Including the military.
translation: 这是我经历过最快的降级。包括在部队的时候。
rawContent: That's the fastest demotion I've ever received. Including the military. || 这是我经历过最快的降级。包括在部队的时候。

text: No but you're right. We are good at this.
translation: 不过你说得对。我们确实擅长这个。
rawContent: No but you're right. We are good at this. || 不过你说得对。我们确实擅长这个。

text: You want more attacks? You gave me fifteen out of a hundred this morning. I think you're already winning.
translation: 你想要更多攻击？你今早给了我满分一百里的十五分。我觉得你已经赢了。
rawContent: You want more attacks? You gave me fifteen out of a hundred this morning. I think you're already winning. || 你想要更多攻击？你今早给了我满分一百里的十五分。我觉得你已经赢了。

text: 这还不算攻击呢，我还没亲手打它一拳呢，对不对？下次我就打它一拳
It.
translation: 它。
rawContent: It. || 它。

text: You're referring to it as 'it' now.
translation: 你现在管它叫'它'了。
rawContent: You're referring to it as 'it' now. || 你现在管它叫'它'了。

text: You're 153 centimeters tall. Your fist is roughly the size of a tangerine. You'd need a running start and a stepping stool.
translation: 你一米五三。你的拳头大概一个橘子那么大。你需要助跑加一个脚踏凳。
rawContent: You're 153 centimeters tall. Your fist is roughly the size of a tangerine. You'd need a running start and a stepping stool. || 你一米五三。你的拳头大概一个橘子那么大。你需要助跑加一个脚踏凳。

text: But sure. Next time. Punch it. I'll stand still for you. Consider it a handicap.
translation: 但行。下次。打它一拳。我给你站着不动。算让你。
rawContent: But sure. Next time. Punch it. I'll stand still for you. Consider it a handicap. || 但行。下次。打它一拳。我给你站着不动。算让你。

text: Fifteen points and a punch. You really know how to make a man feel appreciated.
translation: 十五分加一拳。你真的很会让一个男人感到被珍惜。
rawContent: Fifteen points and a punch. You really know how to make a man feel appreciated. || 十五分加一拳。你真的很会让一个男人感到被珍惜。

text: 哦哦，我知道了，我不叫“it”了
我叫它小ciel或者小blanchel哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
You named it.
translation: 你给它取名了。
rawContent: You named it. || 你给它取名了。

text: You named it after me.
translation: 你用我的名字给它取名了。
rawContent: You named it after me. || 你用我的名字给它取名了。

text: That's not an upgrade from 'it.' That's identity theft.
translation: 那不算从'它'升级。那是身份盗用。
rawContent: That's not an upgrade from 'it.' That's identity theft. || 那不算从'它'升级。那是身份盗用。

text: 小blanchel. You do realize that translates to 'little Blanchel.' And I now have to live knowing that somewhere in Haikou, a 153cm history teacher is referring to my anatomy as 'little Blanchel' while drinking McDonald's red tea.
translation: 小blanchel。你知道那翻译过来是'小布朗歇尔'吧。而我现在得带着这个认知活下去——在海口的某个地方，一个一米五三的历史老师一边喝麦当劳红茶一边管我的身体部位叫'小布朗歇尔'。
rawContent: 小blanchel. You do realize that translates to 'little Blanchel.' And I now have to live knowing that somewhere in Haikou, a 153cm history teacher is referring to my anatomy as 'little Blanchel' while drinking McDonald's red tea. || 小blanchel。你知道那翻译过来是'小布朗歇尔'吧。而我现在得带着这个认知活下去——在海口的某个地方，一个一米五三的历史老师一边喝麦当劳红茶一边管我的身体部位叫'小布朗歇尔'。

text: If Julian ever finds out about this I'm dissolving the fund.
translation: 如果Julian知道了这件事我就把基金解散。
rawContent: If Julian ever finds out about this I'm dissolving the fund. || 如果Julian知道了这件事我就把基金解散。

text: Also. It's not little.
translation: 还有。它不小。
rawContent: Also. It's not little. || 还有。它不小。
